records.title: Discrete Diffusion Models Exploit Asymmetry to Solve Lookahead Planning Tasks
records.reason: The paper compares AR and diffusion-model planning accuracy/training behavior; it does not propose inference efficiency.

records.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of LLM Orchestration and Ensemble Strategies for Sentiment Analysis in Recommender Systems
records.reason: The study reports accuracy and per-5000-prediction API cost for LLM ensembles, but the supplied MDPI primary article URL returned an internal retrieval error. Abstract-level evidence suggests task/cost comparison, not a serving optimization method.

records.title: When More Experts Hurt: Underfitting in Multi-Expert Learning to Defer
records.reason: PiCCE studies learning-to-defer model quality and expert selection, not LLM serving/inference efficiency.

records.title: Learning Physics from Pretrained Video Models: A Multimodal Continuous and Sequential World Interaction Models for Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: PhysGen is a video-world-model robotics method. KV caching/L-MTP are implementation ingredients for the robotics task, not the paper’s inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
records.reason: FeDecider addresses federated cross-domain recommendation and low-rank adapter aggregation; it is a training/federated-learning method.
